content: Pre-formed solids, such as tablets, are uniform in shape and size, typically circular, with either flat or convex surfaces. The distance between the faces of these solids is less than their diameter. Technical Material (TC): This refers to a substance produced during a manufacturing process that includes the active ingredient along with associated impurities. It may also contain small amounts of essential additives. Technical Concentrate (TK): This is a material derived from a manufacturing process that contains the active ingredient and associated impurities. It may also include small quantities of necessary additives and appropriate diluents. Ultra-Low Volume Liquid (UL): A homogeneous liquid formulation that is ready for application using ultra-low volume (ULV) equipment. Vapour-Releasing Product (VP): A formulation containing one or more volatile active ingredients that release vapors into the air. The evaporation rate is typically controlled through specific formulations or dispensers. Water-Dispersible Granules (WG): These are granules designed to be applied after disintegration and dispersion in water. Wettable Powder (WP): A powdered formulation intended for use as a suspension after dispersion in water. Water-Dispersible Powder for Slurry Seed Treatment (WS): A powder that is dispersed at high concentrations in water before being applied as a slurry to seeds. Water-Dispersible Tablet (WT): Tablets designed for individual use, which form a dispersion of the active ingredient after disintegration in water. Other Formulations (XX): A temporary category for all other formulations not listed above. Mixed Formulations (ZC, ZE, ZW): ZC: A stable suspension of capsules and active ingredients in a fluid, typically diluted with water before use. ZE: A heterogeneous fluid formulation containing a stable dispersion of active ingredients in the form of capsules, solid particles, and fine globules within a continuous water phase, usually diluted with water before use. ZW: A heterogeneous fluid formulation with a stable dispersion of active ingredients in the form of capsules and fine globules in a continuous water phase, also diluted with water before use. Discontinued Formulation Codes: Grain Bait (AB): A specialized bait formulation. Block Bait (BB): A specialized bait formulation. Capsule Suspension for Seed Treatment (CF): A stable suspension of capsules in a fluid applied to seeds directly or after dilution. Encapsulated Granule (CG): Granules with a protective or release-controlling coating. Contact Liquid or Gel (CL): A rodenticidal or insecticidal formulation in liquid or gel form for direct application or dilution. Electrochargeable Liquid (ED): A liquid formulation designed for electrostatic spraying. Smoke Generators (FD, FK, FP, FR, FT, FW): Various forms of smoke generators, such as tins, candles, cartridges, rodlets, tablets, and pellets. Granular Bait (GB): A specialized bait formulation. Gel for Seed Treatment (GF): A homogeneous gel formulation applied directly to seeds. Macrogranule (GG): Granules with particle sizes ranging from 2000 to 6000 μm. Flo-Dust (GP): A very fine dustable powder for pneumatic application in greenhouses. Combi-Pack Solid/Solid (KP): Two solid formulations contained separately within one outer pack for simultaneous application in a tank mix. Lacquer (LA): A solvent-based, film-forming composition. Liquid Vaporizer (LV): A liquid formulation in a cartridge or bottle designed for use with a heater unit, where the formulation evaporates into the local atmosphere. Microgranule (MG): Granules with particle sizes ranging from 100 to 600 μm. Vaporizing Mats (MV): Mats made from pulp or other inert materials impregnated with an active ingredient, used in heating units to produce slow volatilization of the active ingredient. Plate Bait (PB): A specialized bait formulation. Gel or Paste Concentrate (PC): A solid formulation applied as a gel or paste after dilution with water. Pour-On Solution (PO): A solution applied to the skin of animals in high volumes, typically more than 100 mL per animal. Seed Coated with Pesticide (PS): A seed application method, not considered a formulation type. Spot-On Solution (SA): A solution applied to the skin of animals in low volumes, typically less than 100 mL per animal. Scrap Bait (SB): A specialized bait formulation. Water-Soluble Powder for Seed Treatment (SS): A powder dissolved in water before application to seeds. Tracking Powder (TP): A discontinued term, now referred to as CP. This includes proprietary interests, employment, consultancy, research support, or any other association with commercial entities related to the subject matter of the meeting or work.
